rule.live_service_definition: (free-to-play, detected from cached store rows, minus pipeline/data/free_not_live_service.txt) OR pipeline/data/live_service.txt
rule.why_not_price_alone: measured 2026-08-01 over 20 ingested titles: free and paid-live-service have indistinguishable veteran shares (50.4% vs 47.7% median) against 32.9% for paid non-live-service; price alone would demote Team Fortress 2 and keep Rust
rule.measured_gate: run_batch.py drops a title after ingestion and before extraction if its real cohort structure is degenerate - ingestion costs no Gemini quota
